How Smart Investors Make Money | Mutual Fund Tips by Mahindra Manulife CEO Anthony Heredia
Want to grow your wealth smartly? 💰
In this exclusive episode, RP Wealth Ramprasad interviews Anthony Heredia, MD & CEO of Mahindra Manulife Mutual Fund.

Discover how young investors should start, how many mutual funds you actually need, why portfolio diversification is not everything, and how Trump tariffs could benefit India!

🔥 Learn:
✅ Smart investor strategies
✅ How many funds to hold
✅ Best fund categories (Flexi cap, Multi cap, Large cap)
✅ How tariffs impact global trade

📌 Don’t forget to Like, Share & Subscribe for more financial wisdom!

Don’t just earn—grow, invest, and prosper! 🌟

This podcast is for educational purposes only. Investments in cryptocurrency and mutual funds are subject to market risks.
